title: Zurned Utils
description: adds zurned utils that add stuff
body:
🛠️ Zurned Utilities

Zurned Utilities is a lightweight server-side utility mod that adds quality-of-life features without changing vanilla balance.

Designed for survival servers and SMPs, it focuses on simple commands, vein mining, and player-friendly utilities.

✨ Features
⛏️ Vein Miner (Sneak-Break)
- Hold sneak (Shift) while breaking to vein mine
- Works with All overworld ores (including deepslate)
- Nether ores
- Logs & stems (trees)
- Automatically breaks connected blocks of the same type
- Hard cap of 500 blocks to prevent abuse and lag
- Drops items naturally (fortune & enchantments apply)

🥩 /glockey Command
- Grants 20 Cooked Beef
- Player-only command
- Useful for testing, survival starts, or small servers

🎯 Intended Use
- Survival & SMP servers
- Small utility packs
- Vanilla-plus gameplay
